text: Uh-oh! Why do so many knowledge hubs fail? Let's spot the seven sneaky traps, so yours won't!
Trap one: Technology first! The agent launches too early, and answers disappoint.
Trap two: No owners! Documents get old, and nobody updates them.
Trap three: Garbage in, garbage out! Duplicates compete, so answers conflict.
Trap four: Metadata as an afterthought! Messy tags make content hard to trust.
Trap five: Governance only on paper! Rules exist, but nobody follows them.
Trap six: No feedback loop! Unanswered questions pile up, and gaps stay open.
Trap seven: Weak change management! People still ask colleagues instead.
So, how do you dodge them? Content first! Clear owners! Clean sources! Required tags! Automated rules! A feedback loop! And show the value!
Dodge these traps, and your hub becomes the place everyone trusts! Let's build it right!
